A large digital clock showing '2:25' is prominently centered, and stylized Chinese text overlays the bottom half of the frame. (2) Cut to a medium shot of a young woman with long dark hair featuring pink under-layers. She is wearing a light blue t-shirt and holding a smartphone, pointing at its screen with her right index finger while looking towards the camera with an animated expression. (3) Transition to another young woman with a short black bob hairstyle wearing a blue and yellow striped crop top. She holds the phone near her face, gesturing excitedly with her hands as she speaks. The background is a brightly lit indoor studio with a white brick wall and wooden furniture. (4) Close-up on the smartphone held by the girl in the striped top. Her fingers swipe across the home screen, highlighting the translucent, glass-like icons of the apps which allow the background image of a girl group to show through. (5) The camera returns to a medium shot of the girl in the striped top as she laughs heartily and tosses her head, her movements energetic and high-spirited. (6) A third young woman with long black hair wearing a yellow tank top and tan pants is shown. She holds the phone and gestures toward a lock screen featuring a close-up of a girl's face. The setting includes shelves with books and small decorative plants behind her. (7) A young man with glasses and a grey t-shirt enters the frame, holding the phone and looking at it with a contemplative expression. A girl is partially visible in the background holding a beverage. (8) The final phase shows a screen recording sequence where a hand navigates through the iOS settings menu, specifically going into Accessibility and Display & Text Size to toggle the 'Reduce Transparency' feature, changing the UI appearance.
